sources.title: Amazon Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.key_requirement_verified: Section 1 defines Special Links; Section 5 mandates verbatim site disclosure: 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.'

sources.title: Amazon Associates Program Policies (Updated April 14, 2026)
sources.key_requirement_verified: Participation Requirements & IP License: requires Associates tag parameter; prohibits static scraped prices/availability/customer star ratings without Creators API/PA-API; prohibits link cloaking or obscuring Amazon destination; prohibits scraping/data mining.

sources.title: Associates Operating Agreement — What's Changed (Effective April 14, 2026)
sources.key_requirement_verified: Added Original Content definition requiring commentary, analysis, or transformation for additional value; 180-day shipping/payment window; paid/boosted ads linking to Amazon disqualified (limited exceptions).

sources.title: Associates Program Standard Commission Income Statement (Table 1)
sources.key_requirement_verified: Official Fixed Standard Commission Income Rates: Kitchen = 4.50%; Home, Home Improvement, Tools = 3.00%; All Other Categories = 4.00%.

sources.title: Onsite Associates Program Commission Income Statement
sources.key_requirement_verified: Onsite Commission Income covers only Direct Qualifying Purchases, with separate Table A and Table B rates (e.g. Tools 1.75%, Kitchen 1.25% onsite) that are distinct from the off-site Standard rates.

sources.title: PA-API 5 Deprecation Notice & Amazon Creators API Migration
sources.publisher: Amazon.com Associates Central — Creators API Documentation
sources.key_requirement_verified: PA-API 5.0 is deprecated (returns HTTP 403 AccessDeniedException); Creators API is the supported REST successor for programmatic catalog, pricing, and offers data.

sources.title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking (16 C.F.R. Part 255)
sources.key_requirement_verified: Material affiliate connections must be clearly and conspicuously disclosed where readers evaluate recommendations; 'paid link' adjacent to links is clear, whereas 'affiliate link' or 'buy now' alone is inadequate; do not make unsubstantiated performance claims.

sources.title: Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?
sources.key_requirement_verified: Requires both clear, conspicuous link-level disclosure (e.g., '(paid link)') and the Operating Agreement site-wide statement.

sources.title: What is the Associates application review process?
sources.key_requirement_verified: Requires at least 3 qualified sales within 180 days (personal orders excluded) and robust original content (rule of thumb: at least 10 posts) using tagged Special Links.

sources.title: Understanding ASINs: Your guide to Amazon’s product identification system
sources.key_requirement_verified: Defines ASIN as a unique 10-character alphanumeric code assigned to every product listed in the Amazon store.

sources.title: Qualify Your Outbound Links to Google (rel="sponsored")
sources.key_requirement_verified: Mark affiliate and paid links with rel="sponsored" so Google understands the commercial relationship.

sources.title: Spam Policies for Google Web Search (Link Spam & Thin Affiliation)
sources.key_requirement_verified: Defines thin affiliation as copying merchant descriptions/reviews without original value; requires editorial oversight, authorship, and properly qualified rel="sponsored" affiliate links.
